name: intakra
description: Find accounts worth your attention and explain why. Connect your Intakra workspace to review owned accounts, recent changes, opportunities, contact evidence and a daily brief. Save an offering or add accounts when requested. Without connecting, review supplied buying-signal evidence and prepare a sourced why-now brief. Empty workspaces get a concrete setup step; no outreach is sent.
